scope: Observed-source fourth legacy search region; no anatomical acceptance
inputs: Original acquired arrays, pinned original frame, three independently replayed unfiltered legacy fourth-region section selections
AB_window: Union of all observed legacy section endpoints, expanded by 1 mm on each side; search margin only
C_window: Between the outermost two historical section planes, inclusive
triangle_eligibility: Whole acquired triangle whose ABC bounding box overlaps the search box; no clipping or moved vertices
connectivity: Original indexed edge adjacency, with all eligible components containing any original legacy section face retained
seed_coverage: All original faces from all three unfiltered section selections must be retained
failure_policy: No alternative crop or filtered replacement when native admission fails
native_admission: No original indexed intersection face, zero-area triangle, ambiguous coincident source vertices, nonmanifold edge or inconsistent winding
native_representation: Exact source-facet charts with source vertex-fan provenance; open acquired boundaries retained
